description: C1's 'IN' clause claims the wake call opens with '... route/leave-time ... — Gemini Live opens immediately with the wake guidance (route INCLUDED via geminiSetupForEvent)'. This is checkable against the real function signature and is false: `geminiSetupForEvent(event, urgency, lang, name, model)` (apps/life-call/lib/call-bridge.cjs:131-137) calls `buildCallPrompt(event, urgency, lang, name)` (apps/life-call/lib/call-logic.js:378), whose signature accepts only `(event, urgency, lang, name)` — no route, duration, or leave-time parameter exists anywhere in this call chain. No code path threads route data into a Gemini prompt today (nor, per FIND-001, is Gemini even on the live path to begin with). The spec asserts a capability that does not exist in either candidate implementation.
